required_documents.name: SF424 (R&R) Cover Component
required_documents.details: Standard institutional cover form for multi-component career development award on ASSIST.

required_documents.name: Project Summary / Abstract
required_documents.details: Summary of the BIRCWH institutional career development program, scientific disciplines, and scholar development goals (max 30 lines).

required_documents.name: Project Narrative
required_documents.details: Two or three sentences on how interdisciplinary training in women’s health and sex differences advances public health.

required_documents.name: Overall Program Strategy
required_documents.details: Maximum 12 pages describing Program Rationale, Career Development Plan, Scholar Selection Process, Advisory Committee, and Program Evaluation.

required_documents.name: Administrative Core Strategy
required_documents.details: Maximum 12 pages describing program leadership, scholar recruitment, fiscal management, and tracking scholar outcomes.

required_documents.name: Professional Development Core Strategy
required_documents.details: Maximum 6 pages describing scholar curriculum, grant-writing workshops, leadership seminars, and career milestones.

required_documents.name: Community Engagement and Outreach Core Strategy
required_documents.details: Maximum 6 pages detailing partnerships, patient advocacy, community-based research, and dissemination of women's health findings.

required_documents.name: Institutional Environment & Commitment Letter
required_documents.details: Letter from the Dean/Chancellor guaranteeing 75% protected research time for scholars, laboratory space, equipment, and departmental support.

required_documents.name: Senior/Key Person Profiles & Mentor Biosketches
required_documents.details: Biographical sketches for Program Director, Research Mentors, and Advisory Committee members (max 5 pages each).
required_documents.source: PAR-27-056-Revised-Full-Announcement.html Section IV.2 Senior/Key Person Profile

required_documents.name: Detailed Budget and Justification (per Component)
required_documents.details: Detailed budget covering scholar salary support (up to 75% effort), research development funds, and core administration costs (8% indirect rate).

required_documents.name: Plan for Instruction in Responsible Conduct of Research
required_documents.details: Maximum 3 pages describing formal training in scientific integrity, mentor-trainee responsibilities, and research ethics.
required_documents.source: PAR-27-056-Revised-Full-Announcement.html Section IV.2 PHS 398 Research Plan

required_documents.name: Registrations (SAM.gov, Grants.gov, eRA Commons)
required_documents.details: Active institutional registrations in SAM.gov, Grants.gov, and eRA Commons for Program Directors.

deadlines.when: October 15, 2026, 5:00 p.m. local time of applicant organization
January 28, 2027, 5:00 p.m. local time of applicant organization
May 28, 2027, 5:00 p.m. local time of applicant organization

eligibility.summary: Institutions of higher education, non-profits, healthcare systems. Only one application per institution (UEI/IPF number) is allowed. In North Carolina, academic medical centers (UNC School of Medicine, Duke Health, Wake Forest Baptist, Brody School of Medicine at ECU) are eligible.

cost_share.details: This NOFO does not require cost sharing as defined in the NIH Grants Policy Statement.

review_criteria.criterion: Program Approach (Scholar selection and mentoring model)
Environment and Institutional Commitment (75% protected time guarantee)

submission_limits: Only one application per institution (normally identified by having a unique entity identifier (UEI) or NIH IPF number) is allowed.
important_notes: Institutional Limit: Exactly one application per institution is permitted; internal competition is required.
BIRCWH scholars must be guaranteed at least 75% protected research time (9 person-months) by the institution.
Multi-component application submitted via ASSIST or compatible system.
